body.p: Nirgushka-Emergen. There were three brothers, three brothers of one mother. The brothers were very rich. There were a lot of horses. The elder brother was [DCh]: Not clear why [easy to] annoy. Once the elder brother got up early in the morning. Having stood up he got plural marking.angry. Having got angry he says to the brothers: "Hey, brothers, get up! What are you sleeping so long? Gather [the] reindeer!" The brothers are sleeping.[DCh]: Pn-marking is unexpectedly 2SG instead of 2PL. The mother got up. Having got up the mother said: "My children! I'm doing badly. I am ill! You(?) go, I(?) will die. The older [DCh]: Pn-marking is completely mixed up in this clause. [StN]: -dÊ¼ÉË-m -- FUT.IMM-1SGbrother heard the mother's words. Having heard he got very angry. Having got angry the elder brother didn't say a single word. He was angry, he was angry and fell asleep, the elder brother slept for five days. On the fifth day the elder brother got up, having got up the elder [StN]: 2SG instead of 2PLbrother said again: "Hey, brothers, what are you sleeping! Gather [the] reindeer!" The brothers are sleeping. The mother got up, having got up the mother said again: "I'm afraid! I'm doing badly! I am ill! My children! Don't go! (?) You go, I'll die!"[DCh]: Imperative marking is missing in the Evenki text.[DCh]: The analysis is quite tentative (cf. also sentence 016). PN forms are unexpected. The elder brother heard the mother's words. Having heard he got very angry again.The elder brother didn't say a single word to the mother. He was angry, he was angry and the elder brother fell asleep again. The elder brother slept for one year. Having slept he got up. Then he said: "Well, now let's go together! One has to gather the reindeer!" The mother says: "My sons! [If] you go to the reindeer, I'll die![DCh]: The analysis is very tentative (cf. also sentences 016 and 029). 2SG instead of 2PL. Make me a wooden coffin! Paint the coffin's lid with red paint, paint the coffin's inside with black paint!" The children listened to the mother's words, then they went off to the reindeers. The brothers were searching their reindeers for ten days, they didn't see a single reindeer. On the fifteenth day, at the edge of the pasture the elder brother saw his reindeer. The elder brother took a bow(?) and a blunt arrow with top(?) [and] went to the reindeers. The elder brother said to [DCh]: The analysis of "lÊ¼ukinduwoÄi" is very tentative. [KAY]: Judging by the the author's translation the Evenki word 'nÊ¼ur' should mean 'a bow'/'Ð»ÑÐºÑ'.the brothers: "I'll go! You(?) look and wait!" The elder brother went off. The brothers are watching. The elder brother reached the reindeers. Having reached [DCh]: The he threw the blunt arrow with top at the reindeers. The blunt arrow with top hit the best reindeer.analysis of "lÊ¼ukinduwaÄi" is very tentative. The blunt arrow with top hit the sledge reindeer at the belly. The elder brother killed the best sledge [DCh]: The analysis of "alakoroji" as compound is tentative.[DCh]: The analysis of "alakoroji" as reindeer. The sledge reindeer shouted to the elder brother: "Why did you kill me in vain?compound is tentative.[DCh]: The analysis of "alakoron" as compound is tentative. You'll be poor! Your life will be hard! It'll be torterous! You will cover your neck with grass (?)! You'll make [DCh]: The analysis of the whole clause is doubtful.a belt(?) out of willows!" So the sledge reindeer said. Then the reindeer flew up.[DCh]: The analysis of "alakoroji" is tentative. Having flewn up it said: "I will never see you(?)! I'll see one younger [DCh]: Pn-marking is confused in the second clause.brother!" The brothers were surprised for a long time. The elder brother said: "What's that for a reindeer?! Strange!" Then the brothers gathered the reindeers again. They [DCh]: gathered all reindeers, then they brought [them] to their own tent. The mother's words were right: Not clear why POSS2SG at emphatic pronoun.the mother has died. The younger brother is crying. The elder brothers are laughing. The younger brother says: "Well, paint the coffin! Let's paint the lid with red paint! Let's paint the coffin's inside with black paint! So the mother told to do!" The elder brothers are laughing again. Having laughed the elder brothers said: "Smear the coffin with coal(?)!" The younger brother didn't [DCh]: Not clear whether 'meat' is right here; the original translation says 'coal', but coal is "ÉËlla ~ ÉËlda" in Evenki. say a single word. The younger brother painted the coffin alone, he painted the lid of the coffin with red paint, he painted the coffin's inside with black paint. He did like the mother has told to. He made a tomb, having made he put his mother [there], he put [her] with the head towards the sun. So he did. Then the three brothers lived again together. They lived for three years, the elder brother became very poor. No prey, no food, he is hungering. The younger brother thought: "How there is no prey? How will we live?" Having thought the younger [DCh]: Not clear why imperative mood here.brother said to the elder brother, the annoyed one: "Elder brother, let's tie sets together! Let's hunt fish!" The elder brother said: "Fine, let's tie [them] together!" They tied nets together, they placed them, there's not a single fish. There are a lot of worms. The elder brothers is eating the worms. The younger brother doesn't eat. The younger brother is hungering. He hungered and hungered, then he said: "Here, together with the elder brother, I'll die! I'll go to another place!" So the younger brother thought. Having thought so, he told the elder brother, then he went off. The younger brother went for three days, he didn't find anything. Then he went again for three days, again he didn't find anything. Again the younger brother went for three days, again he didn't find anything. On the tenth day the younger brother fell down, he is dying.[DCh]: The form "budÉndÊ¼arÉn" is strange, but the stem(?) "budÉn-" for 'to die' seems Then the younger brother said: "Polar foxes, foxes, wolves, eat me!to occur regularly in this text. The polar foxes, foxes and wolves came running, they ate the younger brother's body. "Raven, raven", the [DCh]: According to all younger brother said, "I forgot you! Fly to me! Peck my body!"dictionaries "oli" means 'raven', and not 'eagle'. The raven came flying. Having flewn [there] the raven pecked the younger brother's body once. There the younger brother said: "Hey, raven! It hurts! It is bad like that! Take me [away]!" The raven says: "Where will I bring you?" The younger brother said: "Bring me to the sky! Please, bring me! I'll give you [something] good!" And the raven says: "How will I take you? Your body is eaten up at all!" The younger brother said: "Please, take me! I'll reward you!" The raven says: "Well, krah, krah!" Then the younger brother got healthy. The raven took the younger brother to the sky. The raven was flying and flying, it found a hole in the sky. Only the raven knows the hole in the sky. Having found the hole the raven pushed the younger brother into the hole. Then the raven said: "Go to the sunny side! There you'll find a big river. Swim to the river's opposite side! On the other side you'll find a silver tent!" The younger brother listened, having listened he went off. The younger brother went off to the sunny side. He was going and going, on the third day he found a river, he found a big river. Then he swam over to the river's opposite shore. Having swum over he found a silver tent. In the tent an old man is sitting. Behind the old man a disease is sitting. The younger brother saw the disease. Having seen [it] he said to the old man: "Who is ill at yours, old man?" The old man says: "My daughter is ill." And the younger brother said: "How is she ill?" "Her belly is ill", the old man says. "Help my daughter! [If] you help, take [her]! I'll give my daughter to you!" The younger brother says: "Fine, I'll help!" Then the younger brother is looking at the girl's belly. He was looking and looking and saw wound[s]. In the wound[s] he saw a blunt arrow with top.[KAY]: According to the context the wound should be apparently in singular Having seen he pulled the blunt arrow with top out. Having seen the blunt arrow with top the younger brother is surprised. The younger brother recognized this arrow. This arrow was the elder brother's one. [With] this arrow the elder brother had shot the sledge reindeer.[DCh]: The analysis of "alakoron" is tentative. This girl is the sledge reindeer. So the younger brother thinks and is surprised. The old man said: "Let's live together (?)! Be my son-in-law![DCh]: The analysis of the second clause is tentative. Take my daughter!" The girl got healthy. The younger brother took the girl. They all were living in one tent. The son-in-law is rich, there are many reindeer. So it was. The younger brother was living in the sky for three years. He was living and living. Once the son-in-law said: "Hey, old man! I am bored![DCh]: According to RKM, this means that the younger Let me in my land! Oh, old man, let me!" brother is bored. [RKM]: ÑÐ¿Ð¾ÑÑÐµÐ±Ð»ÑÐµÑÑÑ Ð²Ð¼Ñ£ÑÑÐ¾ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ£ÑÐ¸Ñ â ÑÐºÑÑÐ½Ð¾.The old man listened to his son-in-law. Having listened the old man said: "How did you come here?" The son- in-law says: "I was taken here by a raven!" The old man says: "Well, go to your land! [If] something bad happens to you, I'll know, I'll help you! Don't forget me!" Then the son-in-law went off to the Middle World, [to] his own place. He was going for three years. On the fourth year(?) he found the brothers' coffins along the way. The coffins were [DCh]: Probably not the fourth day, but the fourth year was meant, cf. the sentence before.rotten. Here the younger brother stopped. He is erecting his tent, he lived there. The woman's belly is rising. The woman said to the younger brother: "Go to the sunny side! There at a lake a silver tree and silver grass is growing. Make a birth pole out of the tree. Bring me the birth pole! And bring me silver grass!" The younger brother listened. Having listened he went off to the sunny side. There he found a lake. At this lake he saw a silver tree and silver grass. The younger brother chopped down the high tree, and he made a birth pole. Having made the birth pole he took silver grass. Then he went back into the tent. His wife said: "Have you brought the birth pole?" The husband says: "I have brought a silver birth pole and silver grass!" Then he put up the birth pole. His wife gave birth to a child. Five years passed. The child has no name. The wife said: "The child has no name, the child needs a name! Let's give the child a name!" The husband says: "Which(?) name do we give the child?" The wife said: "Nirgushka-Emergen!" "Fine!", her husband said, and they gave the child the name "Nirgushka-Emergen". Fifteen years passed, the boy Nirgushka-Emergen is apparently a strong boy. Once Nirgushka-Emergen: "My brain is bursting [= I am bored], so alone! [I] need a girl! [It is] bad for a single one! I want a girl!" Father and mother listened to their child. Having listened they thought. They thought for three days. Then the mother said to the child: "There are no beautiful girls in this world. We don't know! There is a girl for you, the sun girl! The sun girl is far away! Go there! Take the sun girl!" Nirgushka-Emergen said: "You send me there to the sun girl! How will I go? Give(?) me a horse with nine legs!" Then the father said: "Here in the middle world there are no horses with nine legs. You won't find anywhere! Such horses exist in the sky! Look for a horse with nine legs there! Make a silver fence! When you have made the fence, sit down! Lift the fence. Sit like that for three days! Then say so: "Spirit, give me a horse with nine legs!" Nirgushka-Emergen listened. Having listened he made a silver fence. Having made the fence he lifted the fence, so he was sitting for three days. Nirgushka-Emergen said so to the spirit: "Hey, spirit! Give me a horse with nine legs! I'll go to the sun girl!" On the fourth day a very high(?) horse with nine legs fell down. Nirgushka-Emergen saw the horse, he was surprised. Then Nirgushka-Emergen went into the tent. The father said: "Did the spirit give a horse with nine legs to you?" The child says: "The spirit has given me a horse with nine legs! The horse is very high! How will I climb onto it? How will I sit down on it?" The father listened to his child, having listened he laughed. Then he said so to the child: "My child, you have now little power (?)! Beat the horse on its head, it will fall down. Then sit down on it and go off!" Nirgushka-Emergen listened to the father's words, having listened he said: "Fine, now I'll go! When I'll come back, I don't know!" So Nirgushka-[StN]: lit. we don't know?Emergen said and he went off to the horse. How his father had said, so Nirgushka-Emergen did, he hit his horse on the head, the horse fell down. Nirgushka-Emergen sat quickly down on the horse, then he went to the sun girl. How many days Nirgushka-Emergen was going, nobody knows. He was going, going, going. Now the horse stopped. The horse is shaking, it snorts, it is afraid. Then the horse was caught at its neck by the devil Baba Yaga. Having caught the [DCh]: According devil Baba Yaga says: "I am a girl, a beautiful girl! I won't let you!to RKM's footnote "ajapÄu" can also mean 'innocent'. You'll be my husband!" Nirgushka-Emergen saw the devil Baba Yaga. Having seen [her] he laughed. Then Nirgushka-Emergen kicked the devil with his feet, the devil Baba Yaga fell down. Nirgushka-Emergen says "ha ha ha! Who is taking you (?)? Ha ha ha", he says, [DCh]: The analysis is very tentative, since pn-marking seems to be confused.then he goes again to the sunny side. He was going, this Nirgushka-Emergen, going and going, how many days he was going, nobody knows. Now the horse stopped again, having stopped it said: "Well, now you walk! You come to the sun and you'll see a small bitch! This bitch is the sun girl. Ask this bitch! Your way branches out twice. On one way the gift for the spirit is apparently a bear (?). On the [DCh]: The sense is quite unclear.[DCh]: The second way it is apparently a sable(?). You go on the second way!" So the horse said, then the sense is quite unclear. Moreover, "ulukiË" actually means 'squirrel' and not 'sable'.horse disappeared. Nirgushka-Emeren went off. He was going, going, going, again nobody knows how many days Nirgushka-Emergen was going. Now Nirgushka-Emergen saw a silver tent. [In] this tent the sun is sitting. Nirgushka-Emergen reached the tent, having reached it he stopped, than he looked at the tent. He doesn't enter the tent. In the tent people heard [something], having heard they said: "Who(?) is coming?" Then a woman came out, having come(?) she sees who has come.[DCh]: "Éwi-" 'to play' in the second clause seems to be a mistake, "ÉmÉ-" ~ Nirgushka-Emergen heard the words. The woman looked at Nirgushka-Emergen."Émi-" 'to come' makes much more sense. The woman was looking and looking and went into the tent again. The people said to the woman: "Who has come?" The woman said: "A human has come." The people said again: "What kind of human has come?" The woman said: "I don't know what kind of human it is! I haven't seen such people! He has(?) a belt, it is a human of the middle world." The people listened to the [DCh]: The sense of the clause is quite unclear, especially regarding the context.woman, having listened they got very angry. The people said so to the woman: "How do you(?) not know what kind of human has come?[DCh]: "bi" 'I' is unexpected in the clause; probably "hiË" 'you' is meant. Why didn't you look well?" The people scolded the woman a lot. They were scolding and scolding and they sent the woman again, they said again: "Look well what kind of human has come!" The woman went again, having gone she watched the human, she watched for a long time, having watched she thought: "What kind of human it is?" She went into the tent again. The people said: "Did you look well what kind of human has come?" The woman said: "I have watched the human well!" The people said again to the woman: "Well, say what kind of human has come!" The woman is silent, she doesn't say a single word. For the second time the people said to the woman: "Well, say what kind of human has come!" The woman is silent for the second time, she doesn't say a single word. There the people said to the woman for the third time: "Well, say what kind of human has come!" The wife said: "Born on a hanging rack? Another one! Did three stars gave birth [to him]? Another one! Were three people here long ago? Those people (?) went off! This human came back!" The old man of the sun listened to the woman, having listened he said: "My people! Open the door! Eighty people, take this human by the hands! Twelve people, each of you put him two sables on his legs! Bring him to me!" The sun people opened the door. Having opened the door, then eighty people went to [DCh]: The form "Åalatduji" is strange, since there seems Nirgushka Emergen, they took him at his arms. Twelve people to be double case marking.took two sables each, they put the sables to Nirgushka-Emergen's feet. Then they brought Nirgushka-Emergen into the tent. The old sun man said: "Go, good guest! Sit down! Nirgushka-Emergen sat down. Then the old sun man said again: "Feed the man well!" Nirgushka-Emergen was fed well by all people. Nirgushka-Emergen is sitting, he doesn't see the girl, the sun girl is not there, there's not a single girl. Now, Nirgushka-Emergen saw the bitch, a beautiful bitch. Then Nirgushka-Emergen stood up, having stood up he bowed to the old sun man and he bowed to the sun woman. Having bowed he said: "Offer me the bitch!" The old sun man listened to Nirgushka-Emergen and said to his wife: "Will we give(?) the bitch to this [DCh]: Actually, the stem of 'to give' is "bu-", maybe there is a simple mispronounciation in the clause.man?" The woman said: "I see, it is the man Nirgushka-Emergen!" Nirgushka-Emergen stood up, having stood up he bowed again to the old sun man, he bowed a second time to the woman. Then Nirgushka-Emergen said: "Now I'll leave! I won't go far! Don't hunt me!" The old sun man said: "Well, go!"[DCh]: Instead of "bu" [we.EX] probably "hu" [you.PL] was meant. Nirgushka-Emergen went off. Nirgushka-Emergen went to another girl, to the moon's daughter. The moon's daughter was taken by Nirgushka-Emergen, then he went back to the sun's tent. Here in the sun's tent he took the sun's daughter, too. Having taken [her] he went back to his own land. How many days he went nobody knows. At one place Nirgushka-Emergen stopped.[DCh]: The analysis of "umnÉjilÄow" is Having stopped he said: "Let's stop here!tentative (see also next clauses); however, there is no verb "umnÉ(jil)-" in dictionaries. You(?) wait a bit! I'll go!" Then Nirgushka-Emergen went off. Having left he[DCh]: Instead of "bu" [we.EX] probably "hu" [you.PL] was meant. found a girl. This girl was the devil Baba Yaga. The Baba Yaga gave birth to a child, to Nirgushka-Emergen's child. The child is lying in the cradle. The Baba Yaga is rocking her child, she is rocking [it] and singing: "Where is your father? Is he coming back? Doesn't he come?" Nirgushka-Emergen killed the Baba Yaga devil. Having killed [her] he took his child and went back to the caravan. The moon's daughter looked at the child, having looked she got very angry, then she threw the child [away]. The sun's daughter looked at the child, having looked she said to Nirgushka-Emergen: "Give me the child! I'll raise [it]!" Nirgushka- Emergen gave his child to the sun's daughter. Nirgushka-Emergen went again to his own land. How many days Nirgushka-Emergen went nobody knows. On the way the sun's daughter said: "I'm feeling bad! It is bad!" So the sun girl said to the moon's daughter. Nirgushka-Emergen reached his own land. He reached his own pasture, then he was surprised, there are no reindeer traces.[DCh]: The analysis of "moniÅ¡" is tentative. The father's tent is not there. Nirgushka-Emergen says: "This is my own land! This is my father's pasture! Where is father's tent? Why are there no reindeer? Why there are no reindeer traces?" Long ago Nirgushka-Emergen had a friend. They played together. His friend's name was Serkesege, so Nirgushka-Emergen thought. Then he went to his friend. On the third day Nirgushka-Emergen found his friend Serkesege. Having found [him] Nirgushka-Emergen said: "Where is my father? Where is my mother? Tell me, friend!" Serkesege said: "Your father and mother [were] eaten by the shaman Kekildan!" Nirgushka-Emergen listened. Having listened he was trembling(?). Then he cried. He got very angry, he was crying heavily. He was crying, crying and crying, and then he said: "Where is the shaman Kekildan living?" Serkesege said: "He went in this direction! Where the shaman Kekildan lives, I don't know!" Nirgushka-Emergen went off. For ten days Nirgushka-Emergen is searching the shaman Kekildan. On the eleventh day Nirgushka-Emergen found the shaman Kekildan. Having found [him] he grabbed him at the neck and said: "Devil! Dog! I'll smash your face! Big-eyed! Die! Stinky one! Say, where is my father? Where is my mother? Give my father! Now give my mother!" The sun's daughter says to her husband: "So it is bad! Don't touch him (?)! Leave [him]! Don't get angry! Don't damage the paths for[DCh]: The analysis is unclear since there is no lexical verb in the clause. the father!" Then the sun girl said to the shaman Kekildan: "Start to shamanize! Make his father and mother alive!" And Nirgushka-Emergen said to the shaman: "Come on, soon! Shamanize! Shamanize well!" The shaman Kekildan is shamanizing. He shamanized and shamanized, and he said Nirgushka-Emergen: "You went to the sky on a horse with eight legs! I know! You took the moon's daughter and the sun's daughter, I know it! You killed the Baba Yaga, I know it! Now I can't [help] you, I won't help. Your father has died! Your mother has died! How will I make them alive? I cannot!" Nirgushka-Emergen listened to the words of the shaman Kekildan, having listened he got very angry. Then he took willows, with the willows he thrashed the shaman Kekildan. He was thrashing and thrashing, and he says: "Give me the parents(?)! Give me the mother!" Then he is thrashing the shaman Kekildan again, he is thrashing [him] badly. "I'll kill [you]!", Nirgushka-Emergen says. "Give me my father! Give me [my] mother! [You] dog!" Then he is thrashing again. The shaman Kekildan said: "Please don't kill [me]! Let me!" Nirgushka-Emergen said: "[You] dog! I'll kill you! Where is my father? Where is [my] mother? Give them to[DCh]: Not clear why DAT/LOC at direct object. me!" The shaman is crying heavily. Nirgushka-Emergen is thrashing [him] all the time. Then the sun girl said: "Will it be a sin? I'll make your father and [your] mother alive! Do you want? Let the shaman Kekildan! Stop thrashing! Stop!" So the sun's daughter says to Nirgushka-Emergen. Nirgushka-Emergen listened. Having listened he is surprised, then he said to the sun woman's daughter: "How will you make it? What do you say? Well, do so!" The sun's daughter said to the shaman Kekildan: "Where are the bones of the old people?" The shaman showed the place where the dead people were, he said: "Here are the bones of the old people!" The sun's daughter walked through the dead people, now the dead people are breathing. The sun's daughter walked past for the second time, the dead people sat up. The sun's daughter went for the third time, the dead people stood up, she had healed [them]. Nirgushka-Emergen was happy. Having rejoiced he let the shaman Kekildan. Having let the shaman Kekildan Nirgushka-Emergen said: "Don't do it again!" Baba Yaga's child is [already] a boy. The boy went off. He is searching his mother. He went to the ground of the ocean, there he is searching his mother. He was searching and searching, he got lost. The boy was eaten by a taimen.
